editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the ISC2 CC Certified in Cybersecurity exam by reviewing all domains covering security principles, network security, and operations.
editorial.overview: The CC Certified in Cybersecurity certification is administered by ISC2 to evaluate baseline competence for all participating candidates. The comprehensive examination covers multiple vital areas including security principles, business continuity, disaster recovery, incident response, access controls concepts, network security, and security operations. Candidates must complete a total of 100 questions during the test session.
editorial.who_should_take: Students, entry-level professionals, prospective employees, and career changers seeking to start a path toward cybersecurity leadership will find this exam suitable for validating their knowledge.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review domain objectives systematically using official ISC2 training materials and available study resources. Take pre-course and post-course assessments, complete end-of-domain quizzes, and use adaptive learning tools to carefully focus your review on areas needing improvement before your scheduled test date to ensure complete success in passing the certification exam.

domain_guidance.summary: Master and summarize the fundamental concepts of information security principles to understand core security requirements and professional obligations required for everyday organizational protection duties without missing any policy objectives.

Differentiate among the purpose, importance, and key practical components of business continuity, disaster recovery, and incident response to ensure proper operational resilience planning and execution across all enterprise environments.

Differentiate between physical access controls and logical access controls to properly manage user access, authentication mechanisms, and system permissions effectively within secure organizational environments according to established security baselines and administrative rules.

Summarize computer networking fundamentals and architecture completely to accurately assess network vulnerabilities, analyze traffic patterns closely, and implement effective preventative mechanisms against modern cyber threats targeting enterprise systems.

Interpret relevant aspects of security operations including data security concepts, system hardening procedures, and security awareness training to maintain strong defenses across enterprise assets and user populations during daily tasks.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Complete the 100 multiple choice questions within the allowed 120 minutes. Manage your pacing carefully to ensure you address all exam items before time expires.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The certification exam consists of a total of 100 multiple choice questions designed to test your knowledge across five core domains of practice during your testing appointment.
The passing score required to successfully pass the examination is 700, which is evaluated on a formal scale ranging from 0 to 1000 for all participating candidates.
Candidates taking the test are given a maximum duration of 120 minutes to completely finish answering all of the designated multiple choice questions presented on the screen.

faq.question_title: What is the price of the exam?
faq.answer_text: The registration price for taking this specific certification exam is set at $0.0, making it uniquely accessible for prospective candidates worldwide who wish to enter the industry.
